description: This file defines a BindingsController class responsible for managing JavaScript bindings in a browser automation context, including adding, removing, and handling binding calls and results.

classes.name: BindingsController
classes.description: Manages bindings between the global context and scripts, allowing adding, removing, and delivering results for bindings.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a new binding to the global context, setting up a function that serializes arguments and communicates with the global binding handler.

methods.name: removeBinding
methods.description: Removes a binding from the global context and marks it as removed.

methods.name: takeBindingHandle
methods.description: Retrieves and deletes a handle associated with a specific binding call.

methods.name: deliverBindingResult
methods.description: Resolves or rejects a promise based on the binding call result or error.
